scope: Full agreed production acceptance; no reduced-scope launch

statusDefinitions.PASS: Full currently approved requirement demonstrated; no implementation inferred from unit tests alone. Intentional merchant-disabled functionality can pass only that disabled-policy requirement.
statusDefinitions.PARTIAL: Implemented and some evidence exists, but required production/customer/lifecycle evidence remains.
statusDefinitions.FAIL: A required observable result demonstrably differs from the agreed rule.
statusDefinitions.BLOCKED: A required platform capability, authorization or external dependency prevents completion.
